plugins.name: meetstream
plugins.description: MeetStream build tracks: the Recording bot (meeting bots, recordings, post-call or real-time transcripts for Zoom, Google Meet and Teams), the Bridge server (agents on your own stack, free local models) and the hosted Agents API (voice agents). Fastest path first: MCP tools or the meetstream CLI, minimal API and SDK calls for app code, with links to the latest docs.
